tools.name: ozon_diagnostics

tools.credentials: Seller Client-Id + Api-Key; optional Performance client_id/client_secret
tools.permission_category: Exact Ozon role/capability mapping not encoded by upstream; verify official documentation before use
notes: Active diagnostics, not passive health; detailed network map in network-map.md
tools.diagnostics: diagnostics.py:full_diagnostics -> 2 host GETs + 12 parallel Seller probes (financial probe expands to multiple requests) + POST /v1/roles + optional Performance token POST. Typical cold-cache two-day one-page financial probe: 18 initial calls with Performance; actual count varies with pagination/cache/errors/retries.
